name: jev-browser
description: Fast browser tools for Claude: raw CDP to a warm, dedicated Chrome, and Jev (TypeSafe's decision model) picking each click and keystroke. MCP tools open, do, act, observe, check, and the jevb CLI with per-driver sessions

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for Jev (TypeSafe System One). Sent only to api.typesafe.ai. Empty: the daemon reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from ~/.claude/plugins/data/jev-browser-vladimirli-plugins/.env.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Use Jev through OpenRouter instead (sent only to openrouter.ai). Used when no TypeSafe key is set.

use_my_chrome.title: Use my own Chrome
use_my_chrome.description: Drive your everyday Chrome (your tabs, logins and extensions) like Claude in Chrome, instead of the plugin's separate one. Needs chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging switched on in your Chrome; Chrome asks you to Allow the first connection.

headed.title: Show the browser
headed.description: Run the dedicated Chrome with visible windows (to log in by hand). Takes effect when the daemon next starts (jevb stop).

haiku_loop.title: Haiku outer loop
haiku_loop.description: When a do falls short (stuck, max_actions, ambiguous), or first for a pick by price or rank, let Claude Haiku, on your Claude subscription through one kept-open claude -p child, read the page and open links, click or run short do sub-goals (at most 8 and 60 s per call). Confirmations, logins and captchas still come back to you. Off by default.
